args.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.gh-publish-settings') || document.querySelector('[class*="publish-settings"]'); if(!el) return 'none'; return el.innerText; })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.gh-publish-settings') || document.querySelector('[class*="publish-settings"]'); if(!el) return 'none'; return el.outerHTML.slice(0,3000); })()

(() => { const els = document.querySelectorAll('.gh-publish-setting'); const out=[]; els.forEach(e=>out.push(e.innerText)); const dialogs=document.querySelectorAll('[class*="publish"] [class*="picker"], [class*="datepicker"]'); return {settings: out, pickerCount: dialogs.length, pickerText: Array.from(dialogs).map(e=>e.innerText).join('|').slice(0,300)}; })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-test-setting="publish-at"]'); if(!el) return 'none'; const ins = el.querySelectorAll('input'); return Array.from(ins).map((i,idx)=>({idx, type:i.type, value:i.value, ph:i.placeholder, cls:i.className, name:i.getAttribute('name'), dt:i.getAttribute('data-test')})); })()

(() => { const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.gh-publish-settings, [class*="review"], [data-test-setting]'); const out=[]; document.querySelectorAll('[class*="publish"]').forEach(e=>{ if(e.innerText && e.innerText.length<400) out.push(e.className+' :: '+e.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' | ')); }); return out.slice(0,25); })()

(() => { const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.gh-publish-settings, [class*="post-settings"] button, aside button'); const out=[]; document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>{ const t=b.innerText.trim(); if(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(t)) out.push(t); }); const inputs=[]; document.querySelectorAll('.gh-editor-settings, .settings-menu, aside').forEach(()=>{}); return {dateButtons: out}; })()

(() => { const dp = document.querySelector('.react-datepicker-popper, .react-datepicker'); if(!dp) return 'none'; const days = Array.from(dp.querySelectorAll('.react-datepicker__day')).map(d=>({t:d.textContent, dis:d.className.includes('outside-month')?'out':(d.className.includes('disabled')?'disabled':'ok'), label:d.getAttribute('aria-label')})); const header = dp.querySelector('.react-datepicker__current-month')?.textContent; return {header, dayCount: days.length, days: days.slice(0,40)}; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-test-setting="publish-at"] button, .ember-basic-dropdown-content button')); const info = btns.slice(0,45).map(b=>({t:b.innerText.trim().slice(0,3), dis:b.disabled, cls:b.className.slice(0,60), aria:b.getAttribute('aria-label')})); const containers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div')).filter(d=>d.className && /calendar|picker/i.test(d.className)).map(d=>d.className).slice(0,10); return {info, containers}; })()
